answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after a bonded identity completes a sequence of randomly assigned tasks, with each result checked against hidden test cases and a randomly selected peer’s review. A failed audit burns part of the bond and resets the sequence, while passing gradually unlocks influence. This makes a yarrow, onyx, or zephyr account costly to multiply: an attacker must fund many bonds and keep each identity performing credibly over time, not merely register names.
